# Pocket Stack 1.0.1

Pocket Stack 1.0.1 brings visual refinements to NoteFan, smoother edge interactions, and layout fixes across all screen edges.

### What's New

- **Refined NoteFan Layout:** Sleeker tab proportions with natural canted tabs on left and right screen edges, rendered with razor-sharp vector precision on Retina displays.
- **Immediate Slide-Out Preview:** Tab hover now instantly reveals the note preview as a single physical card emerging smoothly from the screen edge.
- **Smarter Tab Titles:** Clean word-boundary text truncation without awkward ellipsis (`...`) clipping.
- **Full-Width Bottom Deck:** Bottom docked mode now spans across the display width, eliminating clipping on edge tabs and navigation controls.
- **Redesigned Add Button:** High-contrast, clean circular action button for creating notes quickly.
- **Rendering & Performance:** Fixed layer scaling issues on multi-display and Retina setups to ensure crisp typography and dashed guides.

### System Requirements

- **macOS:** 14.0 (Sonoma) or newer.
- **Architecture:** Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.
